The '''Director of Recruiting''' was a position in the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the title was held by [[Arack Dostryt]].<ref name="BHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>
